name: BaoHuckmon
main_effect: [Your Turn] When you play a Digimon with [Sistermon] in its name, you may digivolve this Digimon into a [SaviorHuckmon] in your hand for its digivolution cost. When this Digimon would digivolve with this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 2.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play a Digimon with [Sistermon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
